findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns the unmodified monitor config
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` into a local `config` and replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with the human-readable display value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original object) rather than the modified `config` copy. As a result the `monitor` context attached to the issue occurrence event always contains the raw integer `schedule_type` instead of the display string, and the whole copy/mutate block is dead code. (The defect is carried over from `mark_failed.py`, but this PR is the natural place to fix it since the function is being moved.) Fix by returning `"config": config`.

findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed with no re-export and no test updates
findings.body: `mark_failed.py` no longer defines `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` or `SimpleCheckIn`, and two of them were also renamed (`mark_failed_threshold` -> `try_incident_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `create_incident_occurrence`). No compatibility aliases are left behind and the PR touches no test or caller files. Any module or test that does `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import ...` or patches `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` / `...get_failure_reason` will now fail at import time or silently patch a non-existent attribute (mock.patch raises AttributeError). Before merging, grep for these names across `src/` and `tests/` and update the references (or add re-exports).
